title: Acme Relay REST API documentation
description: Developer documentation for a fictional team-chat REST API: overview, getting started, authentication, concepts, endpoint reference with parameter and response tables, SDK recipes in Python and JavaScript, and one page per error code. Two targets (HTML5 without OnPrem text, PDF without Cloud text) and two TOCs. Issue #72, epic #66.
